mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 1.0% signals accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 1.0% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 4.5% indicates labor market weakness that precedes corporate earnings deterioration, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) signals broad economic contraction across manufacturing and construction sectors, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in INDPRO and HOUST fails to predict negative returns in more than 55% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%) triggers aggressive monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: In periods with CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%, SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained payroll growth above 100k per month indicates robust labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 100k per month.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 1,100,000 units signals weakening residential demand that reduces consumer confidence and corporate revenue expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST is below 1100.0.

mechanism_narrative: Declining residential sales (RSAFS) combined with rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates housing demand contraction under monetary tightening, producing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: The joint condition of RSAFS decline and FEDFUNDS increase fails to predict negative returns in more than 55% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production declining below its 3-month moving average signals manufacturing sector slowdown that reduces corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: In periods when INDPRO is below its 3-month moving average, SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of cases.
